app_fee.value: No application fee for the doctorate is stated on the KIT pages fetched; the KHYS financing page only says no tuition is charged for a doctorate.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee or application-fee waiver is stated; enrolled doctoral researchers pay semester fees.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement appears on the KIT doctoral pages fetched; each faculty's doctoral regulations set admission.

toefl_min.value: KIT expects a very good command of English, but the page says formal proof such as TOEFL or IELTS is not usually required and gives no minimum score.

notes: Admission is by each faculty under its doctoral regulations, with registration at KHYS (Docata). KHYS says: 'As a rule, a good to very good degree is expected.' Foreign degrees need an equivalence assessment from the International Students Office. Graduate schools with their own portals (KSOP, KSETA, KSQM, GRACE and others) are listed on the KIT Doctoral Programs page. Blocked or missing: https://www.kit.edu/english/doctorate.php returned 404. The ETIT doctoral page (https://www.etit.kit.edu/english/promotion.php) gives no admission requirements and the ETIT 2017 regulations page (https://www.etit.kit.edu/english/3549.php) gave no usable text.
